title: Workforce planning

blocks.heading: Learning objective
blocks.text: Define workforce planning and explain how it helps a business prepare the workforce needed to achieve future objectives.

blocks.heading: Definition
blocks.text: Workforce planning is the process of forecasting the number and skills of employees a business will require to achieve its future objectives.

blocks.heading: Why it matters
blocks.text: A workforce plan helps managers compare future labour needs with the employees and skills likely to be available. The business can then recruit, train, promote or redeploy employees before a shortage or surplus disrupts operations.
